roads.name: Callaghan Valley Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 26 curves in 7.5 miles.
From 1,722 to 2,846 ft, with 1,693 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 60 km/h limit its curves ask for about 0.20 g.

roads.name: Alta Lake Road
words: Properly twisty: 35 curves in 5.0 miles, about 7 a mile.
About 1.1 miles in the middle are tamer.
From 2,055 to 2,340 ft, with 1,257 ft of up and down along the way.
13 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 km/h limit its curves ask for about 0.16 g.
